Independent exact replay: python3 /tmp/opencode/frozen_math_replay.py, cycles(). It builds the 16-state four-bit overlap matrix for literal pattern avoidance and calculates det(I-zA)=-(z+1)(z^5+z^3+z-1); closed walks are labelled memberships, so its logarithmic derivative counts the cyclic language without the run construction.
correctness.rationale: Both domination conditions forbid 000 and 111. For n>=5 two distinct vertices share at most one neighbor, so a repeated nonempty L-signature must consist of the sole central one in a cyclic 00100; the converse holds. In C3 only partitions with a single D vertex work; in C4 the four rotations of 0011 work and both alternating words fail by a two-neighbor collision. For the cyclic language, paired zero and one runs have length 1 or 2, and a singleton one-run cannot sit between two length-2 zero-runs. With k zero-runs, a labelled word has k choices for its distinguished run, while a linear list of k run pairs can be placed at n absolute starts. Comparing these marked objects yields n/k times the transfer trace, even for periodic words. The determinant and exceptional coefficients give the claimed OGF. Its factor 1-z-z^3-z^5 has a simple unique smallest-modulus zero rho by the equality condition of the triangle inequality; the log derivative contributes rho^(-n) with unit amplitude. Positive counts for every n also follow by composing lengths 2 and 3 from zero-runs of length one, except that n=4 needs its separate graph witness.
residual_risks: The count uses labels, ordered sides and open-neighborhood signatures; it is not a rotation quotient or a two-locating-side count.
